tickets.summary: Script to set FOC entry price to 0.01 and retrigger consignment process
tickets.description: For orders mentioned in ticket : SAHME-3403. NERP not accepting 0.00 value from promotion rule discounted FOCs. Script sets totalPrice to 0.01 on FOC order entries and retriggers YS03 consignment business process from sendConsignmentToExternalERP.

recentComments.snippet: Approved by D2C Team. Requesting you to validate the fix and update the status in the ticket cc: ~@email~@email

solution.excerpt:
Script to set FOC entry price to 0.01 and retrigger consignment process
Generated: 2026-09-01T20:58:00.000Z

---

Hi Lerato ,

This PC ticket carries the remediation script for the 30 orders listed in SAHME-3403. The accessory consignments on these orders are stuck because NERP is rejecting the zero-price line items sent by Hybris.

Promotion rules on the ZA store set the accessory totalprice to 0.00 (Free of Charge) while the baseprice retains the original value (e.g. 1499.00 or 1295.00). When Hybris sends the consignment feed to NERP, the TokoSDAdditionalDataPopulator.populateGiftWithPurchaseData() method detects the 0.00 totalprice via TokoOrderService.doesConsignmentContainFOCNonPromotion() and classifies the entry as FOC non-promotion. This triggers a DOC_TYPE override from the region's normal sales order type (YS10) to the FOC order type (YS03). NERP then attempts to look up a valid T184 entry for the combination YS03 + the material's Item Category Group + the FOC item category (YNB1), finds no valid mapping, and rejects the consignment with the error "This order type is not accepted (YS03)".

DB verification confirms this across all 30 orders. Each order is split into two consignments: the _1 consignment containing the phone (SM-F*) shipped successfully with a GERP billing number, while the original consignment containing the accessory (EF-* or EB-* or EP-*) is stuck at SHIPPING_REQUESTED (27 orders) or SHIPPING_PREPARATION (1 order) because NERP never created the sales order. The order process is stuck at waitForWarehouseSubprocessEnd waiting for the accessory consignment to complete. All payments are captured successfully.

By setting the accessory entry totalprice from 0.00 to 0.01, the entry will no longer be classified as FOC non-promotion by doesConsignmentContainFOCNonPromotion(). This prevents the DOC_TYPE override, keeping it as YS10 (normal order), and the item category will use the standard mapping. T184 has valid entries for YS10 + the accessory material groups, so NERP will accept the order. The consignment process is then restarted from the sendConsignmentToExternalERP node to re-send the corrected feed to NERP.

This is the same remediation approach confirmed and successfully applied in SAHME-3392 and SAHME-3386 for the ZA region, and in CLME-2989, CLME-2836, and CLME-4092 for the Chile region where the NERP teams approved sending the zero-price SKU value as a nominal amount.

The script is attached to this PC ticket (script-SAHME-3403-foc-price-remediation.groovy). It is idempotent (only modifies entries where totalprice equals zero) and only restarts processes in ERROR or WAITING state. A reusable approved PC ticket exists under PC-52664 (Closed, REUSABLE label) originally created for SAHME-3375 with the same logic.

Rollback: set totalPrice back to 0.00 and nonGiveAwayFOC back to true on the affected order entries.

Thanks,
Aryan.

## Remediation
- Reusable PC ticket: PC-52664 (Closed, REUSABLE, approved by D2C Team)
- Similar PC: PC-52664 (referenced in ticket description)
- Script: script-SAHME-3403-foc-price-remediation.groovy (attached to PC-53378)
- Parent ticket: SAHME-3403 (Blocks relationship, In Progress)
- Logic: Set FOC entry totalprice from 0.00 to 0.01 on YS03 consignments, restart consignment process from sendConsignmentToExternalERP
- Orders: 30 ZA-region orders from SAHME-3403
- Rollback: Set totalPrice back to 0.00 and nonGiveAwayFOC back to true

Hi Georgina ,

This is a master data creation request for a single TR-region store. The ticket requests creation of PointOfService, StoreEmployeeGroup, UserGroup, Address, and OmnichannelDealer entries in the Hybris backoffice for store C750_007_31536 (HARK MUHENDISLIK, Antalya, TR-07).

The attached Excel file POS_DealerMasterData_Template_SETK Filled_C750_007_31536.xlsx contains the store details on the "Store Details" sheet. The store is an ACS (Authorized Counter Store) type located at Yesilbayir Mah. Hasim Iscan Cad. No: 4 A, Dosemealti, Antalya, postal code 07100, town code TR-07. Managing partner is Umit Ozkurt. Sold To/Partner No. is 7116147, Ship To/Partner is 7116147, phone 5458249532, email info@harkmuhendislik.com, static IP 78.187.209.106, company code 7116147, branch code HARKMUH, latitude 30.60721, longitude 36.98057.

No platform bug or code defect was involved. This is a straightforward master data provisioning request.

The same pattern has been executed 8 times prior via PC tickets: PC-49087 (TKME-2175), PC-50301 (TKME-2222), PC-51658 (TKME-2246), PC-52311 (TKME-2262), PC-52505 (TKME-2286), PC-52670 (TKME-2292), and most recently PC-53353 (TKME-2307, created by aryan.v1 for 3 TR stores). All 8 tickets are Closed and the ImpEx scripts were successfully executed in production.

The remediation is to generate an ImpEx script from the Excel data following the same 6-step pattern used in PC-53353: INSERT_UPDATE PointOfService, INSERT_UPDATE StoreEmployeeGroup, INSERT_UPDATE UserGroup, INSERT_UPDATE Address, INSERT_UPDATE OmnichannelDealer, and the POS-UserGroup link. The OmnichannelDealer type is a custom Samsung Toko type defined in tokocore-items.xml (typecode 10736).

Per the lesson learned from TKME-2307, every field in the generated ImpEx must be cross-checked against the raw Excel source data before uploading to the PC ticket. A typo in the branchCode (DRKKFLORYA instead of DRKFLORYA) was caught during TKME-2307 only because the user asked for a manual cross-check. This time the verification will be done proactively.

Possible remediation:
1. Generate the ImpEx script from the Excel attachment data for store C750_007_31536
2. Perform a field-by-field cross-check of every value in the ImpEx against the raw Excel source data
3. Create a PC ticket with the ImpEx attached, following the PC-53353 pattern (labels: i=masterdata, sc=scripting)
4. After PC approval and execution on SMI-P1, verify in backoffice that POS, StoreEmployeeGroup, UserGroup, Address, and OmnichannelDealer were created for C750_007_31536
5. Rollback: remove the created POS, UserGroups, and OmnichannelDealer entries for C750_007_31536

Thanks,
Aryan.

Generated: 2026-09-01T17:24:31.812Z

---

Hi Lerato ,

I investigated the 30 orders listed in the ticket and confirmed that all accessory consignments are stuck because NERP is rejecting the zero-price line items. Here is what happened.

Promotion rules on the ZA store set the accessory totalprice to 0.00 (Free of Charge) while the baseprice retains the original value (e.g. 1499.00 or 1295.00). DB verification confirms this across all 30 orders. Each order is split into two consignments: the _1 consignment containing the phone (SM-F*) shipped successfully with a GERP billing number, while the original consignment containing the accessory (EF-* or EB-* or EP-*) is stuck at SHIPPING_REQUESTED (27 orders) or SHIPPING_PREPARATION (1 order) because NERP never created the sales order. The order process is stuck at waitForWarehouseSubprocessEnd waiting for the accessory consignment to complete. All payments are captured successfully. Two orders (ZA260806-52232515 and ZA260823-67050593) have already progressed past this stage with their accessory consignments showing COMPLETED status.

By setting the accessory entry totalprice from 0.00 to 0.01, the entry will no longer be classified as FOC non-promotion by doesConsignmentContainFOCNonPromotion(). This prevents the DOC_TYPE override, keeping it as YS10 (normal order), and the item category will use the standard mapping. This is the same remediation approach confirmed and successfully applied in SAHME-3392 and SAHME-3386 for the ZA region, and in CLME-2989, CLME-2836, and CLME-4092 for the Chile region where the NERP teams approved sending the zero-price SKU value as a nominal amount.

The script sets FOC entry totalprice from 0 to 0.01 on YS03 consignments and restarts the consignment process from the NERP SO creation node. Only the order list needs to be updated to match these 30 orders. The script is idempotent (only modifies entries where totalprice equals zero) and only restarts processes in ERROR or WAITING state.

Kindly confirm if we can proceed with applying the 0.01 price to these 30 accessory entries so we can push the orders forward.

Thanks,
Aryan.
